description: Eight trigger inputs combined into one, either as an OR or as an AND

params.text: Picks whether the output fires when any connected input fires, or only when all of them fire on the same sample

inputs.text: One of the eight triggers combined; only connected inputs are counted

outputs.text: Sends a 1ms pulse when the combination is satisfied

notes: in the AND position every connected input has to rise on the same sample, so it suits gates coming from one clock rather than triggers arriving at slightly different times
unconnected inputs are left out of the count, so a single connected input in the AND position behaves as an OR
